Below that line, in smaller grey text, it says:
**"Single-Fam..."**

**Truncation Status:**

*   The subtitle "Single-Family" is truncated with an ellipsis ("...").

**Footer Overlap:**

This popup physically overlaps and obscures the bottom-right section of the table, covering the footer area of the right-most column and part of the row below it.
